title: Nightreach Observatory - Skyweave
_note: Option C lush snes richer register. era snes (8 voices, chords, warm reverb/echo). 84 BPM, 4/4, contemplative A minor blooming to C major, 24 bars. Lonely lead (now with warm reverb), answered by a soft 2nd lead a phrase later — call-and-response across the dome. Lush snes pad CHORDS under a glassy bell arpeggio — the densest, most orchestral texture in the region. Deep sustained low end. Faint clockwork tick + a soft distant timpani-ish (tom) swell at section turns; light shimmer at the seam. Vesper motif stated vast and arpeggiated by lead one (E4->A4->B4 ... C5->B4->A4), then ANSWERED by the 2nd lead in full major over the pads — the motif's clearest, most orchestral bloom in the west, the score plainly reaching toward true dawn. ~6-7 voices (within snes's 8). Last bar G->C pickup voice-leads to bar 1.
